issues.explanation: Chapter 75 says “此后关羽擒于禁、斩庞德,” placing those events after华佗疗伤, but Chapter 74 already narrates them before关羽中弩箭 and the source Chapter 75 merely recaps them without reversing their order.
issues.suggested_fix: Delete the temporal marker and write “关羽擒于禁、斩庞德，威震华夏,” or change it to “此前关羽已擒于禁、斩庞德。”
